name: Kato Emberline
bio: Paints himself in the ash of the last arena he won.
notes: Kato Emberline takes Ashwalker's place (owner, 2026-11-26: "Kato is Ashwalker's true replacement"; "Kato is fine"): the ash-painted look this id had before 2026-11-26, its new model. Drive intake of 2026-11-26 ("ash tribal rigged", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs).
